propDocs.Listbox.multiple: Uses an array of selected values; pressing options toggles them by default.
propDocs.Listbox.orientation: Vertical uses Up/Down; horizontal uses Left/Right.
propDocs.Listbox.activation: Automatic follows focus; manual waits for a press. Omit to use the SDK default for the selection mode.
propDocs.Listbox.loop: Wraps keyboard navigation at the first and last enabled option.
propDocs.Listbox.deselectable: Allows pressing the current single selection to clear it.
propDocs.Listbox.keepInView: Scrolls the focused or initially selected option into view.
propDocs.Listbox.readOnly: Allows browsing while preventing value changes.
propDocs.Listbox.required: Requires a selected value for native form submission.
